mutations.because: A render swapped for a symlink between the check and the read must not be followed: without O_NOFOLLOW the bytes of another file with the same size and time are imported under the reviewed path.
command: a file swapped for a symlink after the check is refused and the link is never followed

mutations.because: Grok PT-8d 2 (owner, 2026-10-11): a render whose size and mtime differ from the reviewed stamp is refused. The stamp is checked again on the open file, so a rewrite between the check and the read is seen.
command: a file rewritten with the same size after the check is refused

mutations.because: A render that grew after the check is refused, and no more than its reviewed size plus one byte is read. Accepting the first bytes of a longer file imports a file nobody reviewed.
command: a file that grows after it was opened is refused

mutations.because: A render that shrank after the check is refused: the buffer would otherwise be imported with zero bytes where the file ended.
command: a file that shrinks after it was opened is refused

mutations.because: The opened render is closed on every path; an import of thousands of renders must not run out of file descriptors.
command: the file is closed once and a close that fails is not thrown

mutations.because: A symlink met at open (ELOOP) is reported as a change while reading, with the render's own path, not as a raw system error.
command: a file swapped for a symlink after the check is refused and the link is never followed
